messages:
sam: quick heads-up — tomorrow's review panel needs a small shuffle. priya asked for an earlier slot. can authors confirm availability? also: please attach a 1-2 line TL;DR to your PRs so reviewers can skim.

priya: I can do 8:30am PT if that helps — earlier is better for me.

alex: 9:15am PT works for me, but can move earlier if needed.

marta: i'm OOO 9–10am, so can't do the 9:15 slot. after 10 is fine.

tyler: happy to take an earlier spot if that unblocks priya — I can go first or second.

sam: ok proposal: priya first (8:30), tyler second (8:45), alex third (9:00). marta will be after the break (~10:15). anyone object?

nina: that ordering works for me. i'll be reviewer on priya + alex.

eng-lead: heads up — can we compress each slot to 20m max (10m walkthrough, 10m discussion) to keep buffer for deep dives? also assign a primary and backup reviewer per slot.

sam: yes let's do 20m slots, backup reviewers: eng-lead for priya, nina for tyler. i'll update the calendar invite.

sam: tentative agenda (will publish final 30m before):

```
8:25 — join / quick sync
8:30 — Priya: authz-cache-eviction (10m walkthrough / 10m Q) [reviewers: nina, eng-lead]
8:50 — Tyler: batcher-tuning (10m / 10m) [reviewers: nina, eng-lead backup]
9:10 — Alex: compile-fallbacks (10m / 10m) [reviewers: eng-lead, nina backup]
9:30 — buffer / followups
10:00 — break
10:15 — Marta: onnx-serialization (10m / 10m) [reviewers: eng-lead, nina]
```

sam: action items:
- authors: add TL;DR to PR + list 2 test prompts (easy to skim)
- reviewers: flag any infra/blocking concerns in PR comments before meeting
- ops: i'll post final agenda + calendar update now.

deploy-bot: calendar invite created — "Review Panel — Engineering" tomorrow 08:30 PT. attendees: sam, priya, tyler, alex, marta, nina, eng-lead. link: https://calendar.example/meet/abc123

alex: thanks — i'll update my PR description with TL;DR now.

sam: great, smooth. i'll ping again 30m before with the final order and dial-in. :thumbsup:
